title: 品牌产品里的微缩世界
prompt:
A hyper-detailed surreal advertising poster for [BRAND NAME].

BACKGROUND: A large deep-toned rounded rectangle in [BRAND NAME]'s signature brand color fills 90% of the frame. Behind the subject, massive cropped brand typography bleeds off-frame, letters constructed from the brand's core material texture (e.g. coffee-stained paper, fabric weave, glass, metal), embossed and lit with sharp directional rim lighting. Subtle noise grain texture overlays the entire background.

SUBJECT: Use the uploaded reference image. Preserve the subject's exact face and skin tone from the reference. The person faces camera in a three-quarter foreground stance, holding the brand's most iconic product directly toward the lens.

EXPRESSION: Restyle the subject's facial expression to match [BRAND NAME]'s brand personality and emotional tone, for example: a warm, inviting smile for a comfort or food brand; intense focus and determination for a sports or energy brand; cool, understated confidence for a luxury or tech brand; playful excitement and joy for a youth or snack brand; quiet contentment and calm for a wellness or nature brand. The expression must feel authentic, not forced, like a real person who genuinely belongs to this brand's world.

OUTFIT: Completely restyle the subject's clothing into a character that naturally belongs to [BRAND NAME]'s universe. The outfit must be role-appropriate, for example: a barista uniform for a coffee brand, a jersey and sneakers for a sportswear brand, a sleek turtleneck for a tech brand, a chef's coat for a food brand, an astronaut suit for a space brand. The outfit's colors must use [BRAND NAME]'s exact brand palette. Add small branded details, logo patches, brand-colored stitching, or signature accessories, that make the look unmistakably tied to [BRAND NAME]. The fabric and texture should be photorealistic with visible material detail. Ambient light from the product glow wraps naturally across the outfit, face, and hands.

SURREAL PRODUCT MOMENT: The product held by the subject opens, spills, or expands into a self-contained miniature world, photorealistic depth, atmospheric haze, and parallax layers. The world inside is thematically tied to [BRAND NAME]'s identity and values. The brand's hero substance (liquid, light, energy, material) flows as a physical force, rivers, beams, streams, or cascades, transitioning seamlessly into real-world vapor, smoke, or light rising above the product and dissolving into volumetric atmosphere at the top of the frame.

GRAPHIC LAYER: Scattered sparkle glyphs ✦ with soft lens-flare halos. Floating micro-elements thematically tied to the brand (leaves, droplets, sparks, petals, pixels, stardust) drift with motion-blur trails. Layered soft fog bleeds from behind the product into the foreground. Film-grade chromatic aberration at frame edges.

TEXT SYSTEM:
— TOP: Rounded pill badge, "[BRAND NAME]", clean sans-serif, white on semi-transparent dark fill
— CENTER-LEFT (vertical): Brand tagline in bold condensed uppercase, 3–4 words
— BOTTOM STRIP: Four feature tags in a row, pill shapes, muted tones, 2-word labels each, reflecting the brand's real product qualities

QUALITY: Unreal Engine render quality, octane lighting, macro lens bokeh on background elements, 8K sharp foreground.

title: 参考角色转像素格斗动画
prompt:
Use the character I uploaded as the reference and make a downloadable looping pixel-art GIF of them performing a signature move.

[Keep the character consistent]
Study the reference and keep every key feature: hairstyle and hair color, face and eye color, marks or scars, outfit colors and patterns, accessories, and their weapon or prop. Same proportions and same look in every frame.

[Pixel art style]
Highly detailed HD pixel art, like premium 2D fighting game sprites: crisp hard-edged pixels, rich palette with pixel shading and highlights, visible fabric folds and hair strands, no anti-aliasing.
Full body, side 3/4 view, same size and same ground line in every frame.

[Design the move]
Pick a move that fits the character's personality, power or weapon (or use the one I give below).
Make it a short, punchy attack anyone can read at a glance: ready stance → wind-up → strike → follow-through → back to ready.
Add an elemental or energy effect that matches the character, rendered as pixel art (e.g. water waves, fire, lightning, petals).
Hair, clothes and effects react naturally to the motion. First and last frame match so it loops seamlessly.

[Output]
Pure white background, fixed camera, character centered with enough margin. No text.
About 12 frames, 1.5–2 seconds, infinite loop.
Deliver an actual multi-frame GIF file I can download.
